A.text: The concentration can be raised for more stimulating procedures such as a local anesthetic injection or extraction.

B.text: Lower concentrations suit minor procedures such as restorations, not injections.

cites.section: Use of Nitrous Oxide for Pediatric Dental Patients › Technique of N2O/O2 administration

C.text: Delivery equipment must never provide less than 25% oxygen, so a mixture with no oxygen is not acceptable.

D.text: Raising the concentration is the stated approach for injections, so stopping is not required.

explanation.text: Nitrous oxide concentration is matched to how stimulating the step is: lower for restorations and higher for injections or extractions.

explanation.text: Oxygen delivery must always stay at or above the minimum of 25%.
